title: PasswordedOP
description: this plugin adds a way to get OP without going to the console it saves time!
body:
- **USAGE:**                                                                                      

```
/po <password> 
```
                                                                                                        

- **DEFAULT:**                                                                                             

```
/po 123456789
```


- **IT IS EDITABLE IN THE CONFIG FILE COMES WITH A CUSTOM EDITABLE MESSAGE:**                                                                      


password: '123456789'
```
messages:
  correct: '&a§lPassword correct! You now have OP permissions.'
  incorrect: '&c§lIncorrect password!'
  usage: '&eUsage: /po <password>'
  already-op: '&e§lYou already have OP permissions.'
```
